evidence.quote: Our opening proposal is $40 million for the class, distributed automatically, plus $12 million in attorneys’ fees and expenses.
We propose a $25 million class fund with automatic payments and $5 million in attorneys’ fees and expenses
any fee amount not awarded to be added to the class fund
its fee is low relative to the firm's investment and lets Brightline keep any fee amount the court declines to award. Counter with a moderate increase in the fund and fee
Whitcombe Reyes has the lowest current total at $34.5 million, with automatic payments and no clear sailing.
The other firms’ current packages are higher, so I will make the same lower counter to them without accepting any term sheet yet.

summary: Plaintiffs raised fees in their opening term sheets, and fees were negotiated alongside the class fund before any final class relief was settled. The transcript expressly links fee treatment to class recovery through the provision adding unawarded fees to the class fund, and Whitcombe’s private reasoning considered its own fee investment. Defense counsel also benchmarked against the lowest competing class-counsel package and ultimately settled with Whitcombe Reyes, but the transcript does not show plaintiffs trading class relief for higher firm fees or a misleading court declaration.
